detail.longDescription: Hello, Mastodon! 👋 We're Tidemark: privacy-first web analytics on one calm page. No cookies, no stored IP addresses, and fully open source (MIT). Self-host it on ordinary PHP hosting, or use our hosted version. Free to start. We'll share product updates, privacy tips and the occasional behind-the-scenes note here. Live demo: https:// app.tidemarkanalytics.com/tide mark Code: https:// github.com/tidemark-analytics/ tidemark # introduction # privacy # opensource # selfhosted # analytics https:// mastodon.social
